front: Give the main views on the decision to use the atomic bomb.
back: To end the war quickly and avoid a costly invasion; also, some argue, to impress the USSR; critics say Japan was near defeat and Soviet entry mattered as much.

front: What were the Nuremberg and Tokyo trials?
back: International tribunals that tried German (1945-46) and Japanese (1946-48) leaders; supporters saw justice, critics 'victors' justice'.
